verdict.rationale: The docs say you can configure the equation that calculates customer risk scores and keep multiple configurations, selecting one per customer. That lets scoring reflect business-specific weighting, but nothing shows you can ingest your own signals into the model. Transaction processing exists but is not shown to feed custom inputs into risk scoring. Missing for 10: documented ingestion of device fingerprints, behavioral data, or custom metadata as scoring inputs; evidence that custom fields can be used in the risk equation; hands-on or independent corroboration.
